prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation atlas for a historical maritime RPG. Image 1 is the FULL-BODY costume and boots reference from the character's current street walk. Image 2 is the FACE AND HAIRSTYLE identity reference. Create a NEW sheet with the requested actions; preserve this exact adult person's face, hair, body proportions, costume colors, accessories, garment lengths and footwear. Detailed realistic hand-painted game illustration, consistent identity throughout, not chibi. All equipment secured at waist, any sword SHEATHED throughout; empty hands for movement and gestures. Props must remain attached to the belt or genuinely held by fingers. No floating props. Every full figure including hair, fingers, feet and cloth fits wholly inside its own equal-sized cell with generous clear gutters. No duplicate extra people, grid lines, borders, labels, lettering, ground shadows, floor or background gradients. The entire background outside every silhouette must be truly transparent with actual ALPHA ZERO, not white or gray partly-transparent haze. Do not crop heads, raised hands or boots. Do not change camera zoom or figure scale between frames. EXACTLY 36 distinct full-body frames in a STRICT 6 columns x 6 rows SQUARE atlas, 2048x2048. Every TWO ROWS are one 12-frame gesture, read left-to-right across the first row then the second row. Frames 1-12 (rows 1-2): stand relaxed facing RIGHT three-quarter, gradually glance around and up, lift one hand to shade eyes at brow, look into distance, lower hand, return to exactly the opening relaxed stance. Frames 13-24 (rows 3-4): same relaxed stance, lift empty right hand through chest level to shoulder level, palm out with five natural fingers, make a small friendly wave, smoothly lower arm and return to opening stance. Frames 25-36 (rows 5-6): same relaxed stance, gradually raise both arms, comfortable overhead shoulder stretch with hands separated, release shoulders, smoothly lower arms and return to opening stance. Body stays in the same position with BOTH FEET planted; no walking, dancing, jumping or combat. All 36 figures face the same RIGHT-side three-quarter camera, with coherent gradual changes and feet on a common baseline. Keep natural human hands and arms attached, normal joint angles. Raised arms need extra transparent top margin. Each 12-frame group must begin and end in the same quiet standing pose. Do not omit rows or replace the 36 frames with a portrait.
